newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's 1996 foreign debt rises to $23 bln.
newsitem.headline: Chile's 1996 foreign debt rises to $23 bln.

text.p: Chile's foreign debt rose $1.3 billion last year to $23 billion, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.
The increase is the result of new loans of $1.2 billion and other factors including a fluctuation in the value of the debt as the result of international currency swings.
New medium and long-term loans totalled $6.6 billion in 1996 with the private sector receiving 85 percent of the fresh funds, said the report.
Most of the new foreign loans were granted for an average seven years, it said.
